Maya: Quick heads-up — did a stability sweep for the kernel handoff policy across H100/L40S tonight. Observed oscillatory throughput when seq ~= 2048 and batch 8-12. Flips between fused/paged kernels every ~200ms. Dropping prefetch/evictor threshold to 0.12 stabilizes throughput but p95 latency goes up. Posting raw numbers below.

Nate: Can you paste the perf summary or a short CSV? :eyes:

Maya: Sure — trimmed output (tokens/s, p50 ms, p95 ms):
```
mode,gpu,seq,bsz,throughput,p50,p95
baseline,H100,2048,8,1200,18,42
handoff,H100,2048,8,980,22,130
handoff_thresh0.12,H100,2048,8,1100,28,310
handoff,L40S,2048,8,820,25,180
```
These are synthetic prompt runs (steady-state, 10k tokens). Handoff run shows large p95 spikes during flips.

Sofia: That pattern screams selector flip under changing KV cache pressure — when it flips kernel it invalidates some prefetched pages and we get tails. Was KV cache footprint stable during the run?

Zhang: KV cache did spike — saw a ~12% footprint bump at ~t=2m on the H100 run, correlates with a throughput drop. Stack shows concurrent prefetch eviction + kernel switch:
```
[120s] prefetch.evictor:evict threshold reached -> start_eviction
[121s] kernel.selector:score(paged)=0.48 score(fused)=0.52 -> choose fused
[121.2s] prefetch:cancel_inflight
[121.5s] pipeline:cache_miss_handling -> p95 spike
```

infra-bot: deploybot: rolled `runtime:canary-osc-handoff-2024-11-06` to cluster h100-enc-2 for repro runs. :shipit:

Nate: Can you share the exact repro command you used? I'll try to reproduce on an A100 node.

Maya: Reproducer:
```bash
export MODEL=opt-13b
export RUN_MODE=steady
export SEQ_LEN=2048
export BATCH=8
./perf_run.sh --gpu h100 --img runtime:canary-osc-handoff-2024-11-06 --sweep 1m
```
I also toggled `runtime.selector.prefetch_evict_threshold` between 0.08..0.2

repro-bot: bisect started -> job id b-20241106-42. Full bisect finished: culprit commit = abc123def (kernel selector scoring update). Suspect we removed a small hysteresis in that change.

Sofia: I'll prototype a small hysteresis + cooldown: require score delta >= 0.05 and enforce min switch interval 500ms. That should avoid rapid flip-flop when scores hover around 0.48/0.52.

Nate: Good plan. Also consider making defaults GPU-family aware (A100 vs H100 vs L40S) — memory allocator variance matters.

Maya: SGTM. I'll run a follow-up sweep across A100/H100/L40S with hysteresis=0.05 and switch_cooldown=500ms and post numbers. If stable, we can land a quick revert of the scoring change or add the hysteresis behind a feature flag. :thumbsup:

Zhang: If you need traces, enable `RUNTIME_TRACE=kernel_select,kv` — I'll watch KV behavior in parallel.

Maya: Will do. Re-running now, ETA ~40m. Will update thread with before/after plots.

repro-bot: bisect summary attached: shows flip rate jumped from ~0.3/s to ~4/s after abc123def on H100 seq>=1024.

Nate: Thanks — ping us when you have the follow-up. If hysteresis helps, we should schedule a perf test matrix (seq: 512/1024/2048, bsz: 4/8/12) across all GPU families.

Maya: Yep — adding that to the run queue. Thanks all.
